name: @levitate/recab-tui
description: A/B slots at a glance, and recab's changes (try, commit, roll back, write a system) with their effect before and after

stories.name: overview
stories.about: Running slot A, committed; slot B's last trial failed and B is the rollback target.

stories.name: trial pending
stories.about: Slot B is set to boot once on the next reboot, as a trial.

steps.expect: Slot B boots once on the next reboot

stories.name: running a trial
stories.about: Running slot B on trial, not committed: the trial service still has to judge it.

steps.expect: Running slot B on trial: not committed

stories.name: status unreadable
stories.about: recab status fails, as on a system recab doesn't manage: the error and what to do.

steps.expect: recab couldn't read the A/B state

stories.name: try the other slot
stories.about: t, Enter, y: set slot B to boot once, then the slots before and after.

steps.expect: Try slot B on the next boot

stories.name: commit a trial
stories.about: Running uncommitted slot B: commit keeps it as known-good and the default.

stories.name: nothing to roll back to
stories.about: A fresh install: Roll back is refused, and the page says why.

stories.name: write a system
stories.about: Write a new system to slot B: a missing path and a non-EROFS file are caught as you type, then typing B confirms.

steps.expect: Type B to erase slot B
Slot B holds the new system

stories.name: change fails
stories.about: Every change fails for want of root: recab's error and the advice to run as root.

stories.name: stage refused
stories.about: recab refuses the stage (exit 21): its own reason is the advice, nothing generic.
